street_name: Unnamed Road - Richmond Park - Robin Hood Gate To Roehampton Gate
site_name: Centre Of Pond 433m From Bungalow 2, 51 Laverstoke Gardens 181m From Unnamed Road
description:
T7708. Oak Tree. Approximately 18 metres in height. Sever Ivy, clear base from foliage, clear access to tree so this will make it easier for the tree to maintain. Tree is situated by the bungalows on the grass area, on the boundary line.
T7709. Hawthorn Tree. Approximately 9 metres in height. Tree is at a mature stage of constant growth at or close to ultimate canopy size, Sever Ivy and clear around base to make tree easier to assess. Situated next to T7708 on the boundary line.
T7710. Malus Tree. Approximately 9/10 metres in height. Lift tree by 2/3 metres, tree is situated outside a residential property, so tree has become a massive disruption as long limbs are low growing, causing a lot of fallen debris. Clear building by 1 metre. leaving the tree from 8 metres in width to 7 metres with a lateral reduction. Tree is situated outside the house of 2 and 3. 
T7716. Oak Tree. Approx 12 metres in height. 7 metres in width. Clear lamp post by 1 metres, reduce roadside leader by 50% to allow more light from the lamp post, tree has become overgrown and reducing leaders will stop high vehicles from hitting them and the leaders are low growing. Pruning this tree will be beneficial for the trees health. Situated by the entrance along the boundary line.
T7718. Lime Tree. 18 metres in height. Remove all deadwood, Lift to crown break, branches have become low growing and now disrupting the footpath. Situated on the green by the footpath upon entrance. 
T7722. Lime Tree. 17 metres in height. Remove all deadwood, lift to crown break, branches have become low growing and now disrupting the footpath. Situated on the other footpath in the middle of T7718 and T7723 on the green area.
T7723. Lime Tree. 17 metres in height. Remove all deadwood, lift crown break, branches have become low growing and now disrupting the footpath, causing slight fallen debris on the conservatory next door. Situated by the path on the side of the flats on the boundary line.
